data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure (open hotel search, type and select destination, pick dates, set rooms/guests, search, then sort), but it lists the sort as Distance/Price, bundles "Search / Update" together, and invents optional amenity filters; it also names no sort parameter, so a browser automation would have to guess some steps.
